title: Unit 2 · going to-future
rule:
Pläne für die Zukunft: **am / is / are + going to + Grundform**
I'm going to visit London. She's going to buy a ticket.
Verneinung: I'm **not** going to … / He **isn't** going to … / They **aren't** going to …
Frage: **Are** you going to …? **Is** he going to …? – Yes, I am. / No, he isn't.

words.s: {I'm going to visit; I am going to visit} my grandma tomorrow.
{We're going to watch; We are going to watch} a film tonight.
{She's going to buy; She is going to buy} a new dress.
{They're going to play; They are going to play} football after school.
Look at the clouds! {It's going to rain; It is going to rain}.
{I'm not going to tidy; I am not going to tidy} my room today!
{He isn't going to come; He is not going to come; He's not going to come} to the party.
{We aren't going to take; We are not going to take; We're not going to take} the bus.
{Are you going to visit} the Tower of London?
What {are you going to do} at the weekend?
"Is she going to sing?" – "No, {she isn't; she is not; she's not}."
Where {is he going to stay} in London?
